course.title: Course Builder
course.description: Create structured courses with modules, lessons, videos, quizzes, and downloadable resources. Our drag-and-drop builder makes it easy to organize your content and deliver an engaging learning experience for your students.

schools.title: Custom Schools
schools.description: Launch your own branded online school with a custom domain, logo, and colors. Your school, your brand -- students see your identity, not ours. Create a professional learning environment that reflects your expertise.

payments.title: Built-in Payments
payments.description: Start selling courses instantly with integrated Stripe payments. Accept credit cards, set up one-time or subscription pricing, offer coupons, and track your revenue -- all without any third-party payment plugins or complicated setup.

students.title: Student Management
students.description: Manage enrollments, track your students' progress, and communicate with them directly. Everything from a centralized dashboard.

branding.title: Custom Branding
branding.description: Your school with your logo, your colors, and your domain. Your students see your brand, not ours. Create a 100% yours experience.

analytics.title: Analytics Dashboard
analytics.description: Know your audience with detailed metrics. Sales, engagement, student progress, and more. Make decisions based on real data.

ai.title: AI Assistant
ai.description: Our artificial intelligence assistant helps you create your landing page, generate course content, and optimize your sales strategy.

testimonial1.name: Maria Gonzalez
testimonial1.text: ITY helped me grow my Spanish school to over 500 students in just one year. The course builder is incredibly intuitive, and my students love the learning experience. I never thought teaching online could be this easy!

testimonial2.name: James Chen
testimonial2.text: Having my own custom domain makes my coding school feel completely professional. Students trust the platform, and the built-in analytics help me understand exactly which lessons resonate most.

testimonial3.name: Sarah Williams
testimonial3.text: Setting up payments was a breeze with the Stripe integration. I went from zero to selling my fitness programs within a day. ITY handles everything so I can focus on what I love -- coaching!

testimonial4.name: David Kim
testimonial4.text: The analytics dashboard showed me that students were dropping off at a specific lesson. I restructured it, and completion rates jumped by 40%. ITY gives you the insights to constantly improve your courses.
